kvkk.intro: Under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (“KVKK”), {hotel} explains below how we process the personal data of people who visit hotelavsar.com and contact us.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
body: Your personal data is processed by {company} as data controller.
Address: {address} · Email: {email} · Phone: {phone}

sections.title: 2. Personal data we process
body: Through the website we process:
list: Identity and contact details: full name, email address, phone number (when you contact us by form, email or WhatsApp)
Request content: the message and preferences you send us
Security data: IP address, browser and device information, access logs
Your language preference (through a functional cookie only)

sections.title: 3. Purposes
list: Answering your questions and requests and providing information about your stay
Keeping the website secure and working properly
Meeting legal obligations (e.g. Law No. 5651)
Responding to requests from competent authorities

sections.title: 4. Legal grounds
body: We process your data under Article 5/2 KVKK: where necessary to establish or perform a contract (c), to comply with a legal obligation (ç), and for our legitimate interests provided your fundamental rights are not harmed (f). In any other case we ask for your explicit consent.

sections.title: 5. Transfers
body: Your data may be shared, only for the purposes above, with Vercel Inc. (USA), which hosts the website, with the email service provider that delivers contact-form messages, and with competent public authorities. Transfers to providers abroad are made in line with Article 9 KVKK.

Online booking takes place in a separate booking system (ElektraWeb – avsarhotel.rezervasyonal.com); the privacy notice on that site applies to data processed there. You are directed to third-party services such as WhatsApp and Google Maps only by your own choice.

sections.title: 6. How we collect data
body: You provide your data through website forms, email, phone and WhatsApp; security data is collected automatically through server logs and cookies.

sections.title: 7. Retention
body: We keep personal data for as long as the purpose requires and for the periods set by law; afterwards it is deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
body: Under Article 11 KVKK you may apply to the data controller to:
list: Learn whether your personal data is processed
Request information if it has been processed
Learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used accordingly
Know the third parties in Türkiye or abroad to whom it is transferred
Request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data
Request deletion or destruction under the conditions of Article 7 KVKK
Request that corrections, deletions or destructions be notified to the third parties concerned
Object to an outcome against you resulting solely from automated analysis
Claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing

sections.title: 9. How to apply
body: Send your request in writing, with information that identifies you, to {address} or to {email}. We will respond free of charge within 30 days at the latest.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what information is processed when you use hotelavsar.com, which cookies we use and which third-party services are involved. Details on personal data processing are in our Personal Data Notice (KVKK).

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
body: The site has no user accounts and takes no payments. We only process information you choose to send us (contact form, email, WhatsApp) and technical logs needed to run the site securely (IP address, browser information, time of access).

sections.title: 2. Cookies
body: We use no advertising or analytics cookies. A single functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers the language you choose. It is necessary for the site to work and is not used for profiling.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings; your language choice may then not be remembered.

sections.title: 3. Third-party services
body: The following services are only used when you choose to, and are subject to their own privacy policies:
list: Online booking: ElektraWeb (avsarhotel.rezervasyonal.com)
Map: Google Maps – no request is sent to Google until you press “Show map”
Messaging: WhatsApp (Meta)
Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen menu: FineDine

sections.title: 4. Security
body: The site runs only over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data.

sections.title: 5. Changes
body: We may update this policy when needed. The current version is always published on this page.

sections.title: 6. Contact
body: For questions, email {email} or call {phone}.

terms.intro: By using hotelavsar.com you accept the terms below. The site is operated by {company}.
